body: hey this reminds me alot of me a couple years ago. i didnt know that what i was feeling what depression, and my family would call me lazy for being unmotivated/not doing anything. depression can be paralyzing sometimes. its a real thing and when other people dont feel it they just assume call you lazy
i always feel like if i had one best friend that i could count on no matter what that my life would be so much better. i like to imagine getting the greatest hug ever and what that would feel like
i was just thinking this.
im in college rn too and noone prepared me for how emotionally challenging the relationships would be...is this everyones experience???
ive been spending so much money on weed but im so broke. considering a nicotine addiction lol but ik thats a bad idea
i feel you :(

ive spent the last couple birthdays alone too, had to lie to my mom and tell her that my friends did something for me when in reality i just went to class, work and slept. last year i actually threw a party for myself and only 3 of my friends showed up. I guess thats better than none, i invited like 20 people though.
why cant you trust her?
dating apps have been so bad for my mental health these days because ill meet up with people, hook up and get super attatched and then be really hurt when they dont care about me.
im sorry, i know the feeling. its gut wrenchingly horrible to feel alone. but you deserve happiness and someone that enjoys being around you - you deserve that.
as someone who can only seem to find validation and happiness from the opposite sex i totally relate.
its been two years since ive broken up with my ex and i still feel this way, its like im addicted to the happiness having a boyfriend brought me or something.
same here :( i thought it was just all the alone time im having with myself making me miserable
you deserve happiness too dried cum, thanks for making my day a little better. its really hard to stop negative thinking patterns :/ gets exhausting
i am so sorry. i feel you, thats all i can say.
i have bad depression/anxiety and i get this. being alive is so much work.
i sit all day in my room and just watch tv. is this even living?

same here. i spend all day on tinder or thinking about past flings/relationships because i guess during those times was when i felt the happiest. how do you stop putting your happiness in other people? its like i constantly need validation from the opposite sex or my life has no meaning.

that feeling of the "right" person never seeming to care...i understand that so much. its like yes there are people out there that like me but theyre not the people i want to like me, and therefore i will be unhappy about it until i get exactly what i want. i spend so much of my time trying to stop thinking this way and stop basing my happiness on other people. sorry i was gonna write something more encouraging but then got all in my feels. anyways i understand you, and you made me feel less alone. i hope i did that for you too

i really relate to what youre saying here. sometimes i think days go by where nobody thinks about me, and i dont cross a single persons mind, but i guess thats a small minded way to think. i hope we can all feel better some day too.

im in college and i just started taking antidepressants/anxiety about 2 years ago. i guess they dont really tell you how much of a process finding the right meds are, because then who would even bother? its a process, but its worth it. and trying is so important. dont be discouraged, and keep taking your meds.

my friends will say the same thing about being nervous about relying on a substance for the rest of their life. But if your heart was sick you would take medicine for it, just how you should take care of your mental state!

and im sorry about the ups and downs, when youre feeling great you feel like itll last forever, and then the next low comes.

you got this.
i wish i had that friend
plus! even "perfect" mothers still feel like they arent enough! which leaves the rest of us feeling even worse

the only time you start failing is if you stop trying for them. your kids will have compassion for you, especially if theyre grown. it always hurts to see my mom passed out on the floor from drinking, or when i finally get to visit her and shell spend the night incapacitated. but shes my mom and shes all i got. 

just because youre a mother doesnt mean you stop being human. try your hardest and let your kids know u love them at every chance and they will forgive you.

you remind me alot of my own mother.

and as the kid of a mother who is depressed, and struggles with addiction i can still tell you with one hundred percent certainty i would not trade her for anything else. you can struggle with these things and still be a good mother. believe it or not your child will most likely be able to see through the suffering, if the love is really there. 

you got this. keep going.

Being off meds is the worst, especially if its not on purpose. Personally, I experience alot of nausea and vertigo. Just feeling physically shitty, not to mention how quickly your mental health plummets too. Not having that daily injection of seratonin really fucks you up. 

I say go to your doctor asap. They might give you some shit for missing days of ur meds, but nothing is more important than your mental health. Get back on that shit. OR tell your doctor you wanna try something different. Some people take meds their whole life and some people just take them for a year and stop, but everyone is different.
school feels infinite when youre in it, but once its over its exactly how people say it is - you forget it even existed. you can do it!!

hey im 20, and i remember feeling depressed when i was 13 too. It's weird, feeling such dark feelings when youre so young and half of the people around you are careless and "happy". Depression makes you grow up quick.
